protocol.sampler: systematic heat bath, signed SW cluster, adjacent parallel tempering each sweep

rule.selection_metric: mean foreground IoU at proxy threshold 128
rule.formula: q=median(|125-d| over d>0), clipped below at 1; alpha nearest log-grid to c/q; b nearest log-grid to 4*k/median(|Delta(alpha)|); beta_paper=N*b
rule.continuous_formula: alpha=c/q; b=4*k/median(|Delta(alpha)|), beta_paper=N*b; c=best training alpha*median training q, k=median training b*median(|Delta|)/4
rule.warning: Exploratory rounded rule on this fixed grid, not a universal optimum or confidence guarantee.

continuous_rule.caveat: Continuous runs have four times as many measurement sweeps as the exploratory fixed grid; this is not a matched-compute comparison of adaptation.
